description: Compact TR8×8(P2) rotary actuator in a two-piece machinable or printable housing, with a stepped sleeve in two flanged output bearings, two screw bearings, a finished sheet-metal sector and retaining rings. The removable fin platform, its pins and the fin blade are excluded; two sleeve mounting holes remain.
releaseRequirements: Resolve each physical component to its fabrication or procurement definition.
Select the housing manufacturing route; specify material, fit allowance, split-face finish, bearing coaxiality and nut retention.
Laser-cut the sector blank and finish its teeth to the selected TR8 screw geometry; qualify backlash, lubrication and contact pattern for the intended load.
Measure the purchased screw blank before machining bearing journals, runouts and retaining grooves.
Specify shaft and bearing fits, measured thrust shims, housing fasteners and toleranced component drawings.
Verify complete travel, clearance, axial retention, loading, fatigue and the user's attachment strength before manufacture.
